t: Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav announced Ramsar status for Sukhna Lake (Sukhna Wetland), Chandigarh, and Sauj Jheel, Uttar Pradesh, raising India's total number of Ramsar sites to 103.
NITI Aayog's Frontier Tech Hub released a Data Centre Evaluation Framework, developed with the Ministry of Power and MeitY, to help States assess data-centre proposals and plan sustainable growth.
India's wholesale price index (WPI) inflation rose to 11.39% in September 2026 from 9.92% in August, according to provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

The Union Government approved India's accession to the Southern Indian Ocean Fisheries Agreement (SIOFA), allowing authorised Indian vessels to fish non-migratory high-seas stocks such as squid, toothfish and alfonsino; announced by the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying.

The Indian Navy completed its maiden command of Combined Task Force 154, the training task force of the 47-nation Combined Maritime Forces, with a handover ceremony in Manama, Bahrain; it had assumed command on 11 February 2026.

The Union Cabinet approved ₹53,428 crore for 2026-27 to 2030-31 for the National Social Assistance Programme, renamed Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana; the disability pension scheme becomes Pradhan Mantri Divyangjan Pension Yojana and its benchmark disability criterion drops from 80% to 40%.
